column1: Every column above is either passed through from upstream unchanged (trimmed of surrounding whitespace) or computed by this service as noted. An empty cell means the value was absent or could not be computed — never a sentinel such as -1 or UNKNOWN. No sub-district geography and no point coordinates are ever released (this service's de-identification allowlist).
This classification is ours, not upstream's: it is how this service groups upstream Report codes under the names a Requester picks from. See docs/disease-groups.md for the authoritative source.
